common.unknownError: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

login.title: Sign in to BOM Agent
login.lead: Bills of materials from design files, with the origin of every decision.
login.name: Name
login.devNote: Local environment: sign-in through the built-in test identity provider. In the cloud you sign in with Amazon Cognito or your organisation's SSO.
login.cloudNote: You sign in on the BOM Agent sign-in page (Amazon Cognito in an EU region). Your organisation may require two-factor authentication.
login.callbackError: Sign-in could not be completed (the link expired or was already used).

onboarding.title: Create an organisation
onboarding.lead: An organisation is your team's shared space: projects, runs, knowledge base and audit log. Its data is kept apart from every other organisation.
onboarding.name: Organisation name
onboarding.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. medtech-krakow.
onboarding.inviteLead: Paste the code from the invitation an administrator sent you.

start.newRunLead: Start from a blank project or a device template – the template fills in the requirements (applied part, power).

stats.activeRunsEmpty: Nothing is running. Start a run for a project.
stats.projectsEmpty: No projects yet. Create the first one and upload its files.
stats.completedEmpty: BOMs ready for review will show up here.

projects.title: Projects
projects.name: Project name
projects.empty: A project holds the files of one device. Create your first project, then upload its KiCad files.
projects.drop: Drag the project files here (KiCad .kicad_sch/.kicad_pro/.kicad_pcb, IPC-2581 .xml, EDIF .edf, ODB++ .tgz/.zip, DXF parts list, CSV BOM) or
projects.dropHint: Up to 64 MB per file. Files are checked in an isolated environment before use.
projects.noFiles: No files yet. Upload a KiCad schematic to start a run.
projects.noRuns: This project has no runs yet.

newRun.title: New run
newRun.lead: Pick a project, a system variant and a model. You will see the result live.
newRun.noProjects: Create a project and upload its files first.
newRun.variantBHint: Rules decide what they can; the LLM handles the rest.
newRun.variantBothHint: Two runs on the same files.

run.title: Run
run.waiting: The run is waiting for a free agent.
run.failedHelp: The run failed: {{error}}. Check the project files and start it again.

panel.title: Line {{line}}
panel.noFindings: The rules reported nothing for this line.
panel.editLead: A correction creates a new BOM version and becomes knowledge of your organisation (never of others).

runs.title: Runs
runs.empty: No runs yet. Start the first one from Home.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.verifyOk: The audit chain is intact ({{count}} events).
audit.verifyBroken: The audit chain is broken from event #{{seq}}. Report this to your security administrator.

settings.title: Organisation settings
settings.invited: Created the invitation. Give this code to the person you invited – it is shown only once:
settings.keysLead: Keys for integrations (CI, PLM). A key works only in this organisation and cannot manage members.
settings.keyCreated: Created the key. Copy it now – it will not be shown again:
settings.ssoLead: SAML 2.0 / OIDC configuration for your organisation becomes available once Amazon Cognito runs in the cloud environment. Until then members sign in with an email account.

errors.notMember: You do not have access to this organisation. Choose another one.
errors.notFound: This item was not found. It may have been deleted or belong to another organisation.

compare.title: Variant comparison
compare.needTwo: Comparing needs two finished runs of this project. Start a run in “Both and compare” mode.
compare.same: Both variants decided the same for every designator.

reference.title: Compare with a reference BOM
reference.lead: Upload a verified BOM (CSV with a designator column, e.g. Reference). We compute line precision, recall and F1, MPN coverage and field accuracy. The file is not stored.

kb.title: Knowledge base
kb.lead: Datasheets, application notes and standards the agents take evidence from (citations on BOM lines). Your organisation's documents are visible only to your organisation; their content is never treated as instructions for the agents.
kb.hint: Up to 32 MB. Files are indexed in the background; scans without a text layer need OCR.
kb.empty: No organisation documents yet. Add datasheets of the parts you use – the variant B agent cites them when choosing MPNs.
kb.globalLead: Shared corpus of public documents maintained by the platform operator (read-only).
kb.globalEmpty: The global corpus is empty in this environment.
